notes.title: MESSAGE TO PLAYTESTERS (New Menu Update)
notes.notes:
Hi, it's Ryan Cho here, the creator of CRASHTEST, I just released an update for the game.
This new update contains a new main menu.
All of the main menus have all been animated, and they all have different backgrounds!
Check them out, enjoy!

Have a nice day,
Ryan.
